description.value: Laughing Llama II is a convenience store sitting directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Cowichan Valley, a well-travelled touring corridor on Vancouver Island. The 'II' in the name suggests it is a second location of a local independent brand. Cyclists riding the Island Highway between Victoria and Nanaimo pass this stretch and would find it a potential roadside resupply point.
